data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 experienced a net run-off deterioration of GBP 12.5 million in prior year reserves. This strengthening was primarily driven by adverse claims development in the Accident & Health class, specifically on an account written in the 2013 underwriting year due to poor attritional loss experience. Further adverse development included an adverse decision on a Specialty Property claim from the 2010 year of account and re-projections leading to loss ratio increases in General Aviation and Airline Liability sub-classes. These adverse movements were partly offset by favourable claims development and reserve releases in the Casualty and Financial classes, and the Aerospace class within Aviation, due to better than expected claims experience.
